script_text: Something is shifting beneath your surface this week, Taurus — and it's not subtle. Early week, Mercury conjunct your ruling planet Venus in your 2nd House of Resources brings sharp financial intuition on Monday and Tuesday, but Mars square Saturn on Wednesday creates frustrating delays with career projects — absolutely avoid signing contracts that day. Thursday's mid-week turning point arrives when the Moon enters your 10th House of Career, trining Jupiter for a powerful professional breakthrough you've been waiting for. The weekend ignites as Venus opposes Uranus in your 7th House of Partnerships on Sunday — expect an unexpected romantic revelation or relationship shake-up that reshapes your priorities. Your best day is Thursday for career momentum. Wednesday is your worst due to that Mars-Saturn tension. Focus on honest communication over compromise — speak your boundaries clearly before Friday. Follow for daily updates.
